# clang-tidy findings in upstream code that only the Windows build reports, as
# scripts/lint-windows.ps1 prints them without the line number. Each has its
# reason above it.

# gpuInfo only uses it on Linux.
src/core/debuginfo.cpp: [misc-include-cleaner] included header qscopeguard.h is not used directly

# Reported only in the Windows build.
src/core/imageprovider.cpp: [bugprone-exception-escape] an exception may be thrown in function '~QsImageHandle' which should not throw exceptions

# copyFileData's read and write loop replaces sendfile on Windows.
src/core/logging.cpp: [bugprone-implicit-widening-of-multiplication-result] performing an implicit widening conversion to type 'size_t' (aka 'unsigned long long') of a multiplication performed in type 'int'
src/core/logging.cpp: [misc-include-cleaner] no header providing "std::min" is directly included

# Unused in the Windows build.
src/core/paths.cpp: [misc-include-cleaner] included header cstdio is not used directly

# Reported only in the Windows build.
src/core/types.cpp: [bugprone-narrowing-conversions] narrowing conversion from 'Int' (aka 'unsigned int') to signed type 'int' is implementation-defined

# stdout comes from the Windows SDK, whose headers are ignored.
src/io/ipccomm.cpp: [misc-include-cleaner] no header providing "stdout" is directly included
src/launch/command.cpp: [misc-include-cleaner] no header providing "stdout" is directly included

# errno is only used when daemonizing on Linux.
src/launch/command.cpp: [misc-include-cleaner] included header cerrno is not used directly

# Only the crash handler uses them, and Windows builds without it.
src/launch/main.cpp: [misc-include-cleaner] included header qdatetime.h is not used directly
src/launch/main.cpp: [misc-include-cleaner] included header instanceinfo.hpp is not used directly
src/launch/main.cpp: [misc-include-cleaner] included header logging.hpp is not used directly
src/launch/main.cpp: [misc-include-cleaner] included header paths.hpp is not used directly
